name: Minimum unique values
description: Data is a list of records; the field named by <field> (a jq path, e.g. actor.account.name) must hold at least <minimum> distinct values.

evaluationMethod.implementationTemplate: ([.[].{{ field }}] | unique | length) as $n | { success: ($n >= {{ minimum }}), details: ("found \($n) distinct {{ field }} values, need at least {{ minimum }}") }
